title: Medan
summary: Raleigh names Medan in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Undated in this intake: no yeere of the World was taken from the covered text except where a chronology entry quotes one. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

standby.note: Standby placement only, placed with "Abraham (Abram)" (a parent). The year is that record's sort year, taken as-is. No reign length or age was added or subtracted. It is not a sort year.

birth.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Chapter 6, Stranger in a Strange Land
birth.note: He quotes Genesis 25:1–2 and names Keturah’s sons. No year is printed. Existing son records are reused. Zimran and Jokshan had no record.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter I, §. IV, sig. 160a–160b
